name: while-anki
description: Review Anki cards in Codex while it works.

interface.longDescription: Review due and new Anki cards inside Codex desktop while it works. Ratings are recorded through local AnkiConnect, and the next card appears without posting a chat message. Choose Off, Long tasks, or Every message for automatic showing. Requires Anki, AnkiConnect, and Node.js 22 or newer on the same computer.
defaultPrompt: Show Anki while you work, then hide it when finished.
